item.title: Drill 2026-10-20: crackme (movsxd)
item.description:
Crackme: find the input (Windows x64, arg in ecx)
``` 48 63 C1 movsxd rax, ecx 48 83 C0 05 add rax, 5 48 C1 E8 20 shr rax, 32 83 F8 FF cmp eax, -1 0F 94 C0 sete al C3 ret ```
Which 32-bit value of `ecx` makes the function return 1? Give the largest one in hex.
ANSWER: **Answer:** `0xFFFFFFFA` (-6). Any `ecx` <= -6 works.
1. `movsxd` sign-extends ecx to 64 bits, so the `add` happens in 64 bits and cannot wrap at 32 bits. 2. `shr rax, 32` keeps only the upper half, which is 0xFFFFFFFF exactly when the 64-bit sum is negative, otherwise 0. 3. So the check is `ecx + 5 < 0`, i.e. ecx <= -6. Opcode `48 63` is MOVSXD (REX.W + 63), not the 32-bit `mov`.
